questions.question: Statement I: Aspirin and Paracetamol belong to the class of narcotic analgesics. Statement II: Morphine and Heroin are non-narcotic analgesics.

options.A: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options.B: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
options.C: Statement I is correct but Statement II is false.
options.D: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is true.

questions.explanation: Aspirin and Paracetamol are non-narcotic analgesics. Morphine and Heroin are narcotic analgesics. Both statements are false.

questions.question: The correct structure of 2,6-Dimethyl-dec-4-ene is:
questions.explanation: 2,6-Dimethyldec-4-ene: 10-carbon chain with double bond at C4-C5 and methyl groups at C2 and C6.

questions.question: BF3 is planar and electron deficient. Hybridization and number of electrons around central atom respectively are:
questions.explanation: BF3 is sp² hybridized, trigonal planar. B has 3 bond pairs = 6 electrons around it. No lone pairs on B.

questions.question: Identify an incorrect statement about Noble gases:

options.A: Noble gases are sparingly soluble in water.
options.B: Noble gases have very high melting and boiling points.
options.C: Noble gases have weak dispersion forces.
options.D: Noble gases have large positive values of electron gain enthalpy.

questions.explanation: Noble gases have weak dispersion forces due to large atomic size, so their melting and boiling points are very LOW, not high.

questions.question: Molar conductance of NaCl, HCl and CH3COONa at infinite dilution are 126.45, 426.16 and 91.0 S cm² mol⁻¹. Molar conductance of CH3COOH at infinite dilution is:
questions.explanation: Λ°(CH3COOH) = Λ°(CH3COONa) + Λ°(HCl) - Λ°(NaCl) = 91.0 + 426.16 - 126.45 = 390.71 S cm² mol⁻¹.

questions.question: Tyndall effect is exhibited by:
questions.explanation: Tyndall effect is exhibited by colloidal solutions. Starch solution is a colloidal solution; others are true solutions.

questions.question: RBC deficiency is a deficiency disease of:
questions.explanation: Vitamin B12 deficiency causes Pernicious anaemia, in which RBCs are deficient in haemoglobin.

questions.question: Dihedral angle of least stable conformer of ethane is:
questions.explanation: The eclipsed conformation is the least stable conformer of ethane. Dihedral angle = 0°.

questions.question: The incorrect statement among the following is:

options.A: Actinoid contraction is greater element to element than Lanthanoid contraction.
options.B: Most of the trivalent Lanthanoid ions are colorless in solid state.
options.C: Lanthanoids are good conductors of heat and electricity.
options.D: Actinoids are highly reactive metals, especially when finely divided.

questions.explanation: Most trivalent lanthanoid ions are COLOURED in solid state (due to f-f transitions), not colorless.

questions.question: Major product in dehydrohalogenation of 2-Bromopentane is Pent-2-ene. This is based on:
questions.explanation: Saytzeff's rule states that in elimination reactions, the more substituted (stable) alkene is the major product. Pent-2-ene is more substituted than pent-1-ene.

questions.question: The correct relationship between CP and CV for one mole of ideal gas is:
questions.explanation: For one mole of ideal gas, CP - CV = R (Mayer's relation).

questions.question: Which polymer is prepared by addition polymerisation?
questions.explanation: Teflon is prepared by addition polymerisation of tetrafluoroethene (CF2=CF2). Nylon-66, Novolac, and Dacron are condensation polymers.

questions.question: Acetone reacted with (i) C2H5MgBr, dry ether (ii) H3O⁺. IUPAC name of product is:
questions.explanation: Grignard reagent (C2H5MgBr) adds to acetone (CH3COCH3) to give tertiary alcohol: CH3-C(OH)(C2H5)-CH3 = 2-methylbutan-2-ol.

questions.question: Match: (a) PCl5, (b) SF6, (c) BrF5, (d) BF3 with shapes (i) Square pyramidal, (ii) Trigonal planar, (iii) Octahedral, (iv) Trigonal bipyramidal
questions.explanation: PCl5: sp³d, trigonal bipyramidal. SF6: sp³d², octahedral. BrF5: sp³d², square pyramidal (1 lone pair). BF3: sp², trigonal planar.

questions.question: Which method can be used to obtain highly pure metal which is liquid at room temperature?
questions.explanation: Mercury (Hg) is liquid at room temperature and is purified by distillation method.

questions.question: CH3CH(CH3)CH=CH2 + HBr in presence of benzoyl peroxide (C6H5CO)2O2. Major product is:
questions.explanation: In presence of peroxide (radical mechanism), HBr adds via anti-Markovnikov rule (Kharash effect). Br goes to terminal carbon: CH3CH(CH3)CH2CH2Br.

questions.question: Tritium, a radioactive isotope of hydrogen, emits which particle?
questions.explanation: Tritium (³H) is radioactive and emits low energy beta minus (β⁻) particles.

questions.question: Correct sequence of bond enthalpy of C-X bond is:
questions.explanation: Bond enthalpy decreases as atomic size increases: C-F > C-Cl > C-Br > C-I because bond length increases and overlap decreases.

questions.question: Number of tetrahedral and octahedral voids in hexagonal primitive unit cell are:
questions.explanation: Hexagonal primitive unit cell has 6 atoms. Tetrahedral voids = 2 × 6 = 12. Octahedral voids = 6.

questions.question: Which of the following is a metal displacement reaction?
questions.explanation: Al is more electropositive than Cr, so it displaces Cr from Cr2O3 (thermite-type reaction). This is a metal displacement reaction.

questions.question: Correct graphical representation of Boyle's law (P vs V) at different temperatures:

options.D: Hyperbolic curves with 600K highest (largest volume at given P)

questions.explanation: At constant T, PV = constant (Boyle's law). Higher T → greater PV → curve shifts outward. At given P, higher T means larger V. 600K curve is outermost.

questions.question: pKb of dimethylamine = 3.27, pKa of acetic acid = 4.77 at T(K). pH of dimethylammonium acetate solution is:
questions.explanation: For salt of weak acid and weak base: pH = 7 + (pKa - pKb)/2 = 7 + (4.77 - 3.27)/2 = 7 + 0.75 = 7.75.

questions.question: Among alkaline earth metal halides, which is covalent and soluble in organic solvents?
questions.explanation: BeCl2 is covalent (due to small size and high charge density of Be²⁺) and soluble in organic solvents.

questions.question: Maximum temperature achievable in blast furnace is:
questions.explanation: Maximum temperature achievable in a blast furnace is upto 2200 K.

questions.question: Ethylene diaminetetraacetate (EDTA) ion is:

options.A: Hexadentate ligand with four O and two N donor atoms
options.C: Bidentate ligand with two N donor atoms
options.D: Tridentate ligand with three N donor atoms

questions.explanation: EDTA is a hexadentate ligand that coordinates through 2 nitrogen atoms and 4 oxygen atoms (from carboxylate groups).

questions.question: 10g of glucose (MW=180) in 250ml, 10g urea (MW=60) in 250ml, 10g sucrose (MW=342) in 250ml. Decreasing order of osmotic pressure is:
questions.explanation: π = iCRT. Moles: Urea=10/60=0.167, Glucose=10/180=0.056, Sucrose=10/342=0.029. Higher moles → higher π. P2(urea) > P1(glucose) > P3(sucrose).

questions.question: Statement I: Acid strength increases as HF << HCl << HBr << HI. Statement II: Bond strength of HX decreases down the group as size increases, so acid strength increases.

options.A: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options.B: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
options.C: Statement I is correct but Statement II is false.
options.D: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is true.

questions.explanation: Down group 17, atomic size increases, H-X bond length increases, bond strength decreases, so easier ionisation, acid strength increases: HF < HCl < HBr < HI. Both statements are correct.

questions.question: Structures of beryllium chloride in solid state and vapour phase are:
questions.explanation: BeCl2 exists as a chain polymer in solid state and as a dimer (Be2Cl4) in vapour phase.

questions.question: For reaction A→B, ΔH = -4.2 kJ/mol and enthalpy of activation = 9.6 kJ/mol. Correct potential energy profile is:

options.B: A higher than B with activation hump (exothermic)
options.C: A and B at same level

questions.explanation: ΔH is negative → exothermic reaction. Products (B) are at lower energy than reactants (A). Activation energy = 9.6 kJ/mol creates an energy hump.

questions.question: Zr (Z=40) and Hf (Z=72) have similar atomic and ionic radii because of:
questions.explanation: Due to lanthanoid contraction, the 4f electrons poorly shield nuclear charge, causing Hf to have almost the same radius as Zr despite being in the next period.

questions.question: All India Radio broadcasts at 1368 kHz. Wavelength of EM radiation is: (c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s)
An organic compound contains 78% carbon by weight, remaining hydrogen. Empirical formula is: (C=12, H=1)
The compound which shows metamerism is:
questions.explanation: C4H10O as ether (R-O-R') shows metamerism: CH3OCH2CH2CH3 and CH3CH2OCH2CH3 are metamers (different alkyl groups on same functional group).

questions.question: Which compound reacts with Hinsberg's reagent to give a solid that dissolves in alkali?
questions.explanation: 1° amines react with Hinsberg's reagent (benzenesulfonyl chloride) to give sulfonamide solid that dissolves in alkali. 2° amines give solid insoluble in alkali. 3° amines don't react.

questions.question: Number of body-centred unit cells in all 14 types of Bravais lattice unit cells is:
questions.explanation: BCC Bravais lattices are: Cubic-I, Tetragonal-I, Orthorhombic-I = 3 body-centred unit cells.

questions.question: Match: (a)[Fe(CN)6]³⁻, (b)[Fe(H2O)6]³⁺, (c)[Fe(CN)6]⁴⁻, (d)[Fe(H2O)6]²⁺ with magnetic moments (i)4.9BM, (ii)0BM, (iii)5.9BM, (iv)1.7BM
questions.explanation: [Fe(CN)6]³⁻: Fe³⁺(3d⁵), CN⁻ strong field → 1 unpaired e⁻ → 1.7 BM. [Fe(H2O)6]³⁺: Fe³⁺, H2O weak field → 5 unpaired → 5.9 BM. [Fe(CN)6]⁴⁻: Fe²⁺(3d⁶) → 0 unpaired → 0 BM. [Fe(H2O)6]²⁺: Fe²⁺ → 4 unpaired → 4.9 BM.

questions.question: Total pressure (atm) of mixture of 4g O2 and 2g H2 in 1L at 0°C is: [R=0.082 L atm mol⁻¹K⁻¹]
CH3CH2COO⁻Na⁺ + NaOH + ? → CH3CH3 + Na2CO3. The missing reagent is:
questions.explanation: Decarboxylation of sodium salt of carboxylic acid requires soda-lime (NaOH + CaO). CaO is the missing reagent.

questions.question: For irreversible expansion of ideal gas under isothermal condition:
questions.explanation: For isothermal process of ideal gas: ΔU = 0 (U depends only on T). For irreversible process: ΔS_total > 0 (entropy of universe increases).

questions.question: Which arrangement is NOT strictly according to properties indicated?

options.A: HF < HCl < HBr < HI : Increasing acidic strength
options.B: H2O < H2S < H2Se < H2Te : Increasing pKa values
options.C: NH3 < PH3 < AsH3 < SbH3 : Increasing acidic character
options.D: CO2 < SiO2 < SnO2 < PbO2 : Increasing oxidizing power

questions.explanation: Down the group, acidic strength increases (H2O < H2S < H2Se < H2Te), so pKa should DECREASE (not increase). Statement B is incorrect.

questions.question: Molar conductivity of 0.007M acetic acid = 20 S cm² mol⁻¹. Λ°(H⁺)=350, Λ°(CH3COO⁻)=50 S cm² mol⁻¹. Dissociation constant is:
Slope of Arrhenius plot (ln k vs 1/T) of first order reaction is -5×10³ K. Value of Ea is: [R=8.314 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹]
questions.explanation: Slope = -Ea/R → Ea = -slope × R = 5×10³ × 8.314 = 41570 J/mol ≈ 41.5 kJ mol⁻¹.

questions.question: NaBH4 / C2H5OH acts on methyl 3-oxobutanoate (acetoacetate ester). Product is:

options.A: Alcohol at ketone, ester intact: OH on C3, OCH3 remains

questions.explanation: NaBH4 is a mild reducing agent — it reduces ketones/aldehydes but NOT esters. The ketone group is reduced to alcohol while the ester group remains intact.

questions.question: Match reactions: (a) CO,HCl/AlCl3,CuCl, (b) R-CO-CH3+NaOX, (c) R-CH2-OH+R'COOH/H2SO4, (d) R-CH2-COOH/X2/RedP then H2O with (i) HVZ, (ii) Gattermann-Koch, (iii) Haloform, (iv) Esterification
questions.explanation: (a) CO+HCl/AlCl3,CuCl → Gattermann-Koch (ii). (b) RCOCH3+NaOX → Haloform reaction (iii). (c) Alcohol+acid/H2SO4 → Esterification (iv). (d) Alpha halogenation of acid → HVZ reaction (i).

questions.question: Which molecule is non-polar in nature?
questions.explanation: SbCl5 is sp³d hybridised, trigonal bipyramidal. Due to symmetry, all dipole moments cancel → μ = 0, non-polar.

questions.question: Which pair is NOT an isoelectronic pair?
questions.explanation: Fe²⁺ has 24 electrons (3d⁶). Mn²⁺ has 23 electrons (3d⁵). They are NOT isoelectronic. Other pairs: O²⁻ & F⁻ both have 10e⁻; Na⁺ & Mg²⁺ both have 10e⁻; Mn²⁺ & Fe³⁺ both have 23e⁻.

questions.question: Vapour pressure of solution at 45°C with benzene:octane molar ratio 3:2. P°(benzene)=280 mmHg, P°(octane)=420 mmHg. Total vapour pressure is:
Match: (a)2SO2+O2→2SO3, (b)HOCl→·OH+Cl·, (c)CaCO3+H2SO4→CaSO4+H2O+CO2, (d)NO2→NO+O with (i)Acid rain, (ii)Smog, (iii)Ozone depletion, (iv)Tropospheric pollution
questions.explanation: (a) SO2+O2→SO3 → tropospheric pollution (iv). (b) HOCl→·OH+Cl· → ozone depletion (iii). (c) CaCO3+H2SO4 → acid rain effect (i). (d) NO2→NO+O → smog (ii).

questions.question: Reagent R in: ArNH2 + NaNO2/HCl (0-5°C) → ArN2⁺Cl⁻ + R → Ar-H. R is:
questions.explanation: Ethanol (CH3CH2OH) acts as a reducing agent to convert diazonium salt to arene (Ar-H). It gets oxidised to ethanal. This is used for replacement of -NH2 by -H.

questions.question: Intermediate X in: Toluene + CrO2Cl2/CS2 → X → H3O⁺ → Benzaldehyde. X is:
questions.explanation: Etard reaction: Toluene + CrO2Cl2/CS2 gives chromium complex intermediate X = C6H5CH(OCrOHCl2)2, which on hydrolysis with H3O⁺ gives benzaldehyde.
